Add a preview ledger-write result contractAdds the 2026-07-31-preview version and versions the ledger-write response into a transaction-id response wrapper plus a body model containing collectionId, optional receipt and application claims, and required transaction state; it also adds a typed 503 rollback error while preserving the earlier result model for older API versions.

+

+  applicationClaims?: ApplicationClaim[];
+}
+
+/**

+@added(Versions.v2026_07_31_preview)

+}
